policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: TikTok is launching an in-app restaurant guide called "Must Eat," based on 40 million user posts, reviews, and comments, directly challenging platforms like Yelp and Google Maps.

Amazon introduced several new Echo devices, including the Echo Show 16 with a larger screen, an Echo Studio speaker featuring a home camera, and a digital picture frame that allows users to add voice notes to photos.
AI labs are reportedly purchasing data from defunct startups to train their artificial intelligence models, indicating a new approach to sourcing information for AI development.

world.summary:
UK Chancellor John Healey announced the 2026 Budget, which includes a 
A
100 energy payment for millions of households, a 3% rise in bank tax, and tax relief for business founders.
At least 64 people died in a high-speed train collision in Spain's Toledo province, prompting Spanish football authorities to postpone 24 Copa del Rey games.
After 92% of ballots were counted in Israel's election, neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor the main opposition appeared to have secured the majority needed to form a government.

Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi conducted a historic visit to Syria, where he met with Ahmed al-Sharaa to discuss enhancing trade, reviving the Baniyas oil pipeline, and fostering regional stability.

us.summary: President Donald Trump announced his administration is "terminating" a Biden-era rule that aimed to reduce planet-warming methane emissions from oil and gas drilling operations.
The Federal Election Commission's campaign finance system went offline days before the midterms, with reports indicating hackers targeted the site.

A new report from the immigration reform advocacy group FWD.us found that the number of state and local officers participating in partnerships with Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has doubled in the last eight months.

science.summary: A new study projects a dramatic increase in the number of people with dementia in the United States over the next 25 years, which will strain the healthcare system.
Merck's mRNA melanoma vaccine trial showed promising results, demonstrating a reduction in the recurrence or death from skin cancer when administered alongside an immunotherapy drug.
